members: @ExceptionHandler(WebExchangeBindException.class) @ResponseBody public ProblemDetail handleValidation(WebExchangeBindException exception) { ProblemDetail problem = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid telemetry packet"); problem.setProperty("errors", exception.getFieldErrors().stream().map(error -> error.getField() + ": " + error.getDefaultMessage()).toList()); return problem; }
public record IngressPacketDto(@NotBlank String deviceId, @NotEmpty @Valid List<SampleDto> samples) { }
public record SampleDto(@NotBlank String metric, @NotNull Instant tDevice, double value) { }
